football_evidence.question: Can Florida International take away Missouri State’s big plays?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 0.2 points.
supporting: When Missouri State has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Missouri State’s offense has allowed a sack on 6.3% of its dropbacks, and Florida International’s defense sacks the quarterback on 6.9% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When Missouri State has the ball (third down): Missouri State’s offense converts 37.4% of its third downs, and Florida International’s defense allows opponents to convert 28.6% of their third downs (FBS average 39.6%).
In his last two games (SMU and Western Kentucky), Locklear averaged 4.4 yards per attempt, against 9.2 in his three games before that.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Florida International’s defensive line No. 41 nationally and Missouri State’s No. 112.
contradicting: When Florida International has the ball (big plays on the ground): Florida International’s offense turns 3.9% of its runs into explosive gains, and Missouri State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 5.7% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).

When Missouri State has the ball (big plays through the air): Missouri State’s offense turns 14.0% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Florida International’s defense gives up explosive gains on 11.3% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.2%).

When Florida International has the ball (the run game against the run defense): Florida International’s offense averages 4.0 yards per carry, and Missouri State’s defense allows 4.8 yards per carry (FBS average 5.0).

When Florida International has the ball (the red zone): Florida International’s offense succeeds on 31.4% of its red-zone plays, and Missouri State’s defense allows success on 44.3% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.5%).
quarterbacks: JJ Kohl has completed 152 of 259 passes (58.7%) for 1,821 yards, 7.0 yards per attempt, 12 touchdowns and 9 interceptions in eight games for Florida International, and has been sacked on 11 of 270 dropbacks.

Zach Marker has completed 8 of 15 passes (53.3%) for 109 yards, 7.3 yards per attempt, no touchdowns and no interceptions in four games for Florida International, and has been sacked on 0 of 15 dropbacks.

Henry Belin IV has completed 84 of 125 passes (67.2%) for 1,062 yards, 8.5 yards per attempt, 8 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in seven games for Missouri State, and has been sacked on 7 of 132 dropbacks.

Skyler Locklear has completed 71 of 108 passes (65.7%) for 788 yards, 7.3 yards per attempt, 4 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in five games for Missouri State, and has been sacked on 9 of 117 dropbacks.
